Sound effects for AI agents

Better SFX has an agent skill. With it, your agent can search the library by what a sound should feel like, download the right files into your project and wire them up in code or a video edit. Install it with one command in Claude Code, Codex or any agent that supports skills: npx skills add devhims/better-sfx. Agents can also read catalog.json and llms.txt without the skill.

npx skills add devhims/better-sfx
  • Ask for the feeling you want, for example "add a soft, glassy success sound to the checkout button".
  • Ask for one matching set when an app needs several sounds, so they sound like they belong together.
  • For a video, ask the agent to place sounds on the cuts and clicks it finds in the edit.
